aiDevTeam.maxDebugCycles.description: Maximum Tester → Debugger → Tester cycles per development segment before the segment is marked blocked.

aiDevTeam.allowCommands.description: Allow the Coder, Tester and Debugger agents to execute terminal commands in the workspace.

aiDevTeam.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for commands executed by agents.

aiDevTeam.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum tool-call rounds an agent may perform in a single task.

aiDevTeam.assignModelsPerAgent.description: Give each agent the language model best suited to its job: frontier models (Claude Fable, GPT Astrea) first for design, coding, testing and debugging, a fast model for the Summarizer. When disabled, every agent uses the model selected in the chat model picker.

aiDevTeam.models.markdownDescription: Override the model preference per agent. Each value is an ordered list of case-insensitive fragments matched against the model id, family and name (e.g. `["fable", "astrea"]`); the newest available model matching the first fragment wins. Roles without an entry use the built-in defaults; if nothing matches, the chat model picker's model is used. Run `@devteam /models` to see the available models and the current assignment.
